sentences.text: Gaucher disease type I and type II are both linked to the gene GBA1 in curated databases [e_d56da1ee4888] [e_8a9c88239791].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_34272bdebcd2].
For type II, laryngospasm, a sudden tightening of the voice box, and progressive loss of mental and movement skills are listed as frequent [e_d9b377ad254b] [e_e331af0d5f97].
Both are curated with a confidence of 0.6 [e_d9b377ad254b] [e_e331af0d5f97].
For type I, a completed phase 3 study in children and a recruiting study on biomarkers are listed [e_e5b3331b78b8] [e_91a2d1ff7629].
A listed study shows research is happening and does not show what it found [e_e5b3331b78b8].
A grant on fat metabolism and nerve disease is listed for type I, with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_dea5f08b6182].
These edges list no study and no symptoms for type I in common with type II, so they do not compare the two types [e_8a9c88239791].
